name: Witco
positioning: The occupant app for French office buildings — services, bookings, access and building communication in one place.
description: Witco provides a white-label mobile application for office buildings and workplaces: room and desk booking, access and badge integration, service requests, on-site retail and concierge services, events, communication and occupant feedback.
real_estate_use: Landlords and corporate occupiers use it as the single interface between the building and the people inside it. Practically, it consolidates what used to be five channels — an email for building notices, a booking tool, a paper ticket for maintenance, a WhatsApp group for events — into one app whose usage data also indicates how the building is really used.
features: White-label occupant mobile app for a building or campus
Access control and mobile badge integration
Service requests routed to facilities or providers
Occupant satisfaction measurement and usage analytics

use_cases.job: Give employees one app for booking, access, services and building news
Offer occupants a service layer that supports the rent and the renewal
